description: This file defines a ROS2Bridge class in Python that provides methods for initializing, publishing, subscribing, calling services, creating services, and retrieving message and service histories, simulating an interface between an interpreter and ROS2 for robotic communication.

classes.name: ROS2Bridge
classes.description: A mock implementation providing an interface for ROS2 communication, including topics, services, and message history management.

methods.name: bool initialize(self, node_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the ROS2 node with optional custom node name.

methods.name: bool publish(self, topic: str, message: Dict[str, Any], msg_type: str = "std_msgs/String")
methods.description: Publishes a message to a specified ROS2 topic.

methods.name: bool subscribe(self, topic: str, callback: Callable, msg_type: str = "std_msgs/String")
methods.description: Subscribes to a ROS2 topic with a callback.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] call_service(self, service_name: str, request: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Calls a ROS2 service with request data and returns a response.

methods.name: bool create_service(self, service_name: str, callback: Callable, srv_type: str)
methods.description: Creates a ROS2 service with a callback.

methods.name: List[str] get_topic_list(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of active topics.

methods.name: List[str] get_service_list(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of available services.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_message_history(self, limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Retrieves recent message history with an optional limit.

methods.name: shutdown(self)
methods.description: Shuts down the ROS2 bridge and clears resources.
